content: I am writing this letter of recommendation for Mr Raunak Choudhary, who has been an invaluable asset to our team at Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) during his tenure from August 2021 till date. I have worked closely with Raunak in his capacity as an AWS Developer (System Engineer) in the Computer Consultancy department. Tata Consultancy Services (TCS) is a renowned Indian multinational IT services and consulting company, operating in 150 locations across 46 countries, with a massive employee strength worldwide. We pride ourselves on providing IT services and consulting to global clients and our success is built on the dedication of individuals like Raunak. One of the most significant projects that Raunak was involved in during his time at TCS was the "Data Centre Exit and AWS Migration" for a global media conglomerate. This project was of paramount importance to the client due to stringent licensing obligations, which demanded the swift migration of multiple applications from the data center to Amazon Web Services (AWS). Despite being a fresher, he played a pivotal role in leading the infrastructure team from the TCS side, ensuring that the project met its timelines. His proactiveness in leading both external and internal discussions, and farsightedness were highly appreciated and he received the "Star of the Quarter" award from TCS for his outstanding contributions to the project. In his role, Raunak showcased a remarkable set of skills and domain knowledge. His technical competencies in AWS, DevOps, Infrastructure as Code (CloudFormation), Data Science and Machine Learning were nothing short of flawless. Furthermore, his excellent communication greatly contributed to the success of the projects he was involved in. As a professional, he was technically sincere, dedicated and result-oriented. Beyond his official projects, Raunak went the extra mile by providing process-related training to members from other projects working for the same client. This voluntary effort exemplifies his commitment and willingness to contribute to the overall success of our organization. Moreover, it also showcased his remarkable interpersonal, teamwork and leadership qualities. His ability to work under stress, display emotional maturity and work with low supervision made him a responsible team member. I would rate him among the top 10% of professionals at his level that I have been associated with during my career. Overall, Raunak Choudhary is an exceptional professional who consistently exceeded expectations during his tenure at TCS. His technical prowess, paired with his behavioral traits, made him a valuable asset to our team. I wholeheartedly recommend Raunak for any endeavor he chooses to pursue, as I am confident that he will bring the same level of expertise to any future role.

content: I am writing to express my enthusiastic support for Raunak, a former student of mine, in the Department of Computer Science and Engineering at Shri Madhwa Vadiraja Institute of Technology and Management. He was always actively involved in class, participating in class activities, asking questions to clear his doubts, and engaging in stimulating discussions. Moreover, he was a quick learner who was able to grasp complex concepts in the subject of Design and Analysis of Algorithms (DAA) which I had taught with little aid. He was showcasing his enthusiasm to gain an in-depth comprehension of the underlying concepts. Furthermore, his creative approach to assignments and the timely completion of tasks demonstrated both his skill and commitment to his academic responsibilities. His presentations and seminars were thoroughly prepared, exhibiting a clear understanding of the topics and an exceptional ability to articulate complex concepts to his peers. His adeptness in these areas was reflected in the clarity and efficacy of his communication and explanations. In addition to his academic ability, he actively participated in various extracurricular activities.
